naca0012_m015_inviscid.notes: Cd 0.00092876, Cl 0.00029664 and 4.18 residual orders. Last 10% Cd ranges 0.000929–0.001000, a material fraction of the very small numerical drag; report discusses inviscid numerical drag. Numeric force summary is in immutable c2fefc1:solver/report/generated/force_table.tex and the case text; residual, force and contour references in generated/case_sections.tex:16,:22,:44 are included by report.tex:875 and were visually reviewed in the indexed PDF. Prior retrospective score 2 rested on the incorrect assertion that these committed plots were absent. Structural validation was previously recorded; independent grid convergence was not established.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.
